title: Ridgeline Door Contract Credit Table: Removal, Bundle and Referral Figures
content:
Credit figures for Entry & Patio Door Contracts, by door series.

| Door series | Removal share of the series base price per unit removed | Fewest door units a contract may keep after removal | Window bundle discount on the door contract price | Bundle window between the two signing dates | Referral credit per referred household | Most referral credits per door contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door | 100% | 1 | 3% | 60 calendar days | $100.00 | 3 |
| Ridgeline Portal 520 Smooth Fiberglass Entry Door | 100% | 1 | 3% | 60 calendar days | $100.00 | 3 |
| Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door | 100% | 1 | 4% | 60 calendar days | $100.00 | 3 |
| Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door | 100% | 1 | 4% | 60 calendar days | $150.00 | 3 |
| Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door | 100% | 1 | 5% | 60 calendar days | $150.00 | 3 |
| Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door | 100% | 1 | 5% | 60 calendar days | $200.00 | 3 |

## Definitions

- **Removal share**: the share of the series base price per unit credited for each door unit removed before order release. At 100% the credit per removed unit is the full series base price per unit.
- **Fewest units kept**: the fewest door units a contract may keep after units are removed for credit.
- **Window bundle discount**: a discount on the door contract price, granted as a credit, when the customer also signs a Ridgeline window contract within the bundle window.
- **Bundle window**: the most calendar days that may separate the signing dates of the door contract and the window contract for the bundle discount.
- **Referral credit**: the credit per referred household that signs and completes installation of its own Ridgeline contract.
- **Most referral credits**: the most referral credits one door contract can receive.

## Hypothetical readings

- A Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door contract signed at $12000.00 corresponds to a bundle percentage of 5%, that is $600.00.
- Three referral credits on a Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door contract total three times $150.00, that is $450.00; 3 is the most that contract can receive.
- The removal share is 100%, the fewest units kept is 1 and the bundle window is 60 calendar days in every series.
